text: Oog is back.
scene: {CAVE} smiling in a city street, sparkles

text: Forty thousand years old, and now he needs a job.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a city street, the word "JOB" above him

text: We'll give him eleven jobs and start the timer each time.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a city street, a clock [TIMER 0:00]

text: In one job, he's the best worker in the building.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a museum, sparkles [TIMER FOREVER]

text: In another, he's fired in three seconds.
scene: {CAVE} shocked next to a burning building, an exclamation mark [TIMER 3 SEC]

text: And the job he'd be best at
scene: {CAVE} smug in a museum, a question mark

text: is the one nobody would ever hire him for.
scene: {SCI} shocked in a lab, a big question mark

text: Same rules as last time.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "RULES" above him

text: Oog is a real Homo sapiens with the same brain as you.
scene: {SCI} proud next to {CAVE} smiling, a chalkboard

text: He's strong, fast, and great with a spear.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, in a cave

text: He doesn't speak your language, can't read, and has never seen money.
scene: {CAVE} confused, the word "MONEY" above him, a question mark

text: His resume is short.
scene: {CAVE} proud holding a book, the word "RESUME" above him

text: Skills: spears, fire, tracking, and staying alive.
scene: {CAVE} smug, holding a spear, in a cave, sparkles

text: Previous employer: a very large mammoth.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, next to a mammoth in the snow

text: The timer stops when he quits, gets fired, or gets escorted out.
scene: a manager angry, pointing, the word "FIRED" above him

text: From the longest shift to the shortest. Let's go.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, a clock [TIMER 0:00]

text: Job one: night security guard.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a mall at night, the word "GUARD" above him

text: An empty building, all night, keeping watch.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a mall at night, a flashlight

text: For Oog, this isn't a job. It's Tuesday.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a mall at night, the word "TUESDAY" above him

text: Scientists tracked the sleep of the Hadza in Tanzania with motion sensors.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "HADZA" above him

text: In more than two hundred hours of nights,
scene: a Hadza hunter asleep by a campfire at night, z letters

text: everyone in the group was asleep at the same time
scene: three Hadza hunters asleep at night, z letters

text: for just eighteen minutes.
scene: {SCI} shocked at a chalkboard, the word "18 MIN" above him, an exclamation mark

text: Someone was almost always awake, listening for lions.
scene: a Hadza hunter thinking by a campfire at night, the moon

text: Older people tended to fall asleep early, and younger ones stayed up late.
scene: an old woman asleep and a Hadza hunter thinking by a campfire at night, z letters

text: So the night was covered in shifts, with no schedule needed.
scene: {SCI} proud at a chalkboard, the word "SHIFTS" above him

text: Oog patrols. He hears every sound.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a mall at night, a flashlight, the word "LISTEN" above him

text: At three in the morning, a vending machine hums.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a mall at night, the word "HUM" above him, an exclamation mark

text: He guards it until sunrise.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, in a mall at night, the word "SAFE" above him

text: Timer: all night. Promoted.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a mall, sparkles, the word "PROMOTED" above him [TIMER ALL NIGHT]

text: Job two: construction.
scene: {CAVE} happy at a construction site, the word "BUILD" above him

text: Carry heavy stuff all day? Easy.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, at a construction site, sparkles

text: Oog's whole life is carrying meat, wood and rocks back to camp.
scene: {CAVE} proud, holding a spear, in a forest, the word "CARRY" above him

text: He lifts a bag of cement like a baby goat.
scene: {CAVE} smug at a construction site, a worker shocked

text: The problem is the hard hat.
scene: a worker pointing at {CAVE} confused at a construction site, the word "HAT" above them

text: Oog has never worn a hat in his life.
scene: {CAVE} confused at a construction site, the word "HAT" above him, a question mark

text: He uses it as a bowl.
scene: {CAVE} happy eating at a construction site, the word "BOWL" above him

text: Then there's the elevator.
scene: {CAVE} confused at a construction site, the word "ELEVATOR" above him

text: A tiny metal cave that closes its mouth and moves.
scene: {CAVE} terrified at a construction site, an exclamation mark

text: Oog takes the stairs. All twelve floors. Carrying the cement.
scene: {CAVE} proud, sweating, at a construction site, the word "12 FLOORS" above him

text: And he keeps building a fire on the third floor.
scene: {CAVE} happy by a campfire at a construction site, a worker terrified

text: Timer: eight hours, and a written warning.
scene: a manager angry at a construction site, {CAVE} sad [TIMER 8 HOURS]

text: Job three: chef.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a restaurant kitchen, the word "CHEF" above him

text: Oog knows fire. Oog knows meat.
scene: {CAVE} happy by a campfire in a cave, the word "MEAT" above him

text: Some scientists think cooking helped make us human.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, a light bulb above him

text: Cooked food is softer, and our bodies can get more energy out of it.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "ENERGY" above him

text: Humans have probably used fire for hundreds of thousands of years.
scene: a timeline, {CAVE} by a campfire, the word "FIRE" above him

text: So the grill? Perfect.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a restaurant kitchen, sparkles

text: The menu? He can't read it.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a restaurant kitchen, the word "MENU" above him, a question mark

text: He checks every steak the way he always has: by smell.
scene: {CAVE} thinking in a restaurant kitchen, the word "SNIFF" above him

text: The health inspector is watching.
scene: an inspector shocked in a restaurant kitchen, the word "INSPECTOR" above him

text: A customer orders a vegan salad.
scene: a customer smiling in a restaurant, the word "SALAD" above him

text: Oog serves a whole roasted fish, with the head.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a restaurant, a fish, a customer shocked

text: Timer: five hours.
scene: a manager angry in a restaurant kitchen, {CAVE} sad [TIMER 5 HOURS]

text: Job four: delivery.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a city street, a box, the word "DELIVERY" above him

text: No car, no bike. Oog runs.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, in a city street, a box

text: And humans are surprisingly good at that.
scene: {SCI} smug at a chalkboard, the word "RUN" above him

text: In the Kalahari, some hunters chased antelope in the midday heat
scene: a Hadza hunter proud on a savanna, the word "CHASE" above him

text: until the animal overheated and gave up.
scene: a Hadza hunter happy on a savanna, the word "TIRED" above him

text: It works because humans cool down by sweating, and most animals can't sweat like we do.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SWEAT" above him

text: It's rare and exhausting. One researcher recorded only ten of these hunts in the central Kalahari in sixteen years.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, the word "10 HUNTS" above him

text: About half of them worked.
scene: a Hadza hunter proud on a savanna, the word "HALF" above him

text: So Oog runs all day without stopping.
scene: {CAVE} happy, sweating, in a city street, a box, sparkles

text: One small problem: house numbers.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a city street, the word "NUMBERS" above him, a question mark

text: Every package goes to the house that smells the most like pizza.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a city street, a box, the word "PIZZA" above him

text: Timer: three hours.
scene: a manager angry, pointing at {CAVE} sad in a city street [TIMER 3 HOURS]

text: Job five: schoolteacher.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a classroom, the word "TEACHER" above him

text: The first known schools date back about five thousand years, in Mesopotamia.
scene: a scribe smiling in Mesopotamia, a stone tablet with "5000", the word "SCHOOL" above him

text: Before that, kids learned by watching adults and playing.
scene: a baby {CAVE} happy and {WOMAN} smiling by a campfire, hearts

text: So Oog's lesson plan is simple.
scene: {CAVE} smug at a chalkboard, the word "LESSON" above him

text: Lesson one: how to start a fire with two sticks.
scene: {CAVE} happy by a campfire in a classroom, three children shocked

text: The fire alarm disagrees with lesson one.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a classroom, the word "ALARM" above him, an exclamation mark

text: He takes the class outside to track a squirrel.
scene: {CAVE} happy in a forest, three children smiling, the word "TRACK" above them

text: The kids love it.
scene: three children happy in a forest, hearts

text: The parents do not.
scene: three parents angry, pointing, the word "PARENTS" above them

text: Timer: one hour.
scene: a manager frowning in a classroom, {CAVE} sad [TIMER 1 HOUR]

text: Job six: barista.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a coffee shop, the word "BARISTA" above him

text: People have been drinking coffee for only about five hundred and fifty years.
scene: a timeline, a cup, a stone tablet with "550"

text: The earliest clear records come from Yemen.
scene: a timeline, the word "YEMEN" above it, a cup

text: Religious groups there drank it to stay awake during night prayers.
scene: a timeline, the word "AWAKE" above it, a cup

text: Oog has never had caffeine in his life.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a coffee shop, a cup, a question mark

text: He tastes one espresso.
scene: {CAVE} happy, holding a cup, in a coffee shop

text: Then another.
scene: {CAVE} shocked, holding a cup, in a coffee shop, sparkles

text: Then six more.
scene: {CAVE} shocked, sweating, in a coffee shop, the word "SIX" above him, an exclamation mark

text: Now he's faster than the coffee machine.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, in a coffee shop, sparkles, the word "FAST" above him

text: He's also writing every customer's name as a cave drawing.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a coffee shop, a cup, a customer confused

text: Timer: forty minutes.
scene: a manager angry in a coffee shop, {CAVE} sweating [TIMER 40 MIN]

text: Job seven: call center.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a call center, a headset, the word "CALLS" above him

text: A voice talks inside his head.
scene: {CAVE} terrified in a call center, a headset, the word "HELLO" above him

text: But nobody is there.
scene: {CAVE} terrified in a call center, a big question mark

text: For Oog, a voice with no body is a spirit.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a call center, the word "SPIRIT" above him, an exclamation mark

text: The first telephone call was made in eighteen seventy-six.
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "1876", the word "PHONE" above it

text: For Oog, that's a little under forty thousand years in the future.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a call center, a headset, a timeline

text: He tells the spirit to leave.
scene: {CAVE} angry, shouting in a call center, the word "LEAVE" above him

text: The spirit was a customer asking about a refund.
scene: a customer angry on a phone in a living room, the word "REFUND" above him

text: Timer: ten minutes.
scene: a manager angry in a call center, {CAVE} sad [TIMER 10 MIN]

text: Job eight: cashier.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a supermarket at a cash register, the word "CASHIER" above him

text: Oog can count, sort of.
scene: {CAVE} thinking in a supermarket at a cash register, the word "COUNT" above him

text: A bone from Border Cave in South Africa, about forty-three thousand years old,
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "43000", the word "BONE" above it

text: has twenty-nine notches cut into it.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, the word "29" above him

text: Some researchers think it was used for counting.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "COUNTING" above him

text: Maybe days. Maybe the phases of the moon. Nobody knows for sure.
scene: {SCI} confused at a chalkboard at night, the moon, a question mark

text: But money? Coins appeared only about two thousand six hundred years ago.
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "2600", the word "COINS" above it

text: Oog doesn't take your card.
scene: {CAVE} confused at a cash register, the word "CARD" above him, a big red X

text: He trades: one fish for your groceries.
scene: {CAVE} happy at a cash register in a supermarket, a fish, a customer shocked

text: Timer: five minutes.
scene: a security guard angry in a supermarket, {CAVE} sad [TIMER 5 MIN]

text: Quick scoreboard.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "SCORE" above him

text: Night guard: all night. Construction: eight hours. Chef: five hours.
scene: {SCI} proud at a chalkboard, the word "ALL NIGHT" above him

text: Delivery: three hours. Teacher: one hour. Barista: forty minutes.
scene: {SCI} pointing at a chalkboard, the word "40 MIN" above him

text: Call center: ten minutes. Cashier: five minutes.
scene: {SCI} smug at a chalkboard, the word "5 MIN" above him

text: And it only gets worse from here.
scene: {CAVE} sad in a city street, a big question mark

text: Job nine: dog walker.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a park, the word "DOGS" above him

text: Here's the thing: Oog has never seen a dog.
scene: {CAVE} confused in a park, a big question mark

text: The oldest clear genetic evidence of dogs is around fifteen thousand years old.
scene: a timeline, a dog, a stone tablet with "15000"

text: In Oog's time, those animals were wild wolves.
scene: {CAVE} terrified, a wolf angry in the snow, the word "WOLF" above him

text: Competitors for the same meat.
scene: {CAVE} angry, holding a spear, a wolf angry in the snow

text: So six wolf-shaped animals run toward him, barking.
scene: {CAVE} terrified in a park, a dog happy, an exclamation mark

text: He climbs the nearest tree.
scene: {CAVE} terrified in a tree in a park, a dog happy, the word "UP" above him

text: The dogs think it's a great game.
scene: a dog happy in a park, hearts, sparkles

text: Funny thing: later, those same wolves became our best hunting partners.
scene: {CAVE} happy, holding a spear, a dog happy in the snow, hearts

text: But that deal was made long after Oog's time.
scene: a timeline, a dog, the word "LATER" above it

text: Timer: thirty seconds.
scene: a dog happy in a park, {CAVE} scared [TIMER 30 SEC]

text: Job ten: firefighter.
scene: {CAVE} proud next to a burning building, the word "FIREFIGHTER" above him

text: Remember how precious fire is to Oog?
scene: {CAVE} happy by a campfire in a cave at night, hearts

text: If your fire went out in the Ice Age, you could freeze.
scene: {CAVE} sad in the snow at night, the word "COLD" above him

text: People carried embers and protected their fire like treasure.
scene: {CAVE} proud by a campfire in the snow at night, the word "TREASURE" above him

text: Some groups in recent history, like the Andaman Islanders, were reported to carry fire with them instead of starting it from scratch.
scene: a Hadza hunter proud by a campfire, the word "CARRY FIRE" above him

text: Lose it, and you might have to beg the neighbors for a light.
scene: {CAVE} sad in the snow at night, the word "NEIGHBORS" above him

text: And here, people point a giant water snake at it.
scene: a firefighter happy next to a burning building, the word "WATER" above him

text: Oog sees a huge, beautiful fire, and men trying to kill it.
scene: {CAVE} shocked next to a burning building, an exclamation mark

text: So he protects the fire.
scene: {CAVE} angry, holding a spear, next to a burning building, a firefighter shocked

text: Timer: three seconds.
scene: two firefighters angry, pointing at {CAVE} sad [TIMER 3 SEC]

text: So is Oog just unemployable?
scene: {CAVE} sad in a city street, the word "JOBLESS" above him

text: No. There's one job where he's the best in the world.
scene: {SCI} smiling at a chalkboard, a light bulb above him

text: Museum guide in the Stone Age hall.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a museum, the word "MUSEUM" above him, sparkles

text: A sign says cavemen dragged women around by the hair.
scene: {CAVE} angry in a museum, the word "MYTH" above him, a big red X

text: There's no good evidence for that. It's an old cartoon idea.
scene: {SCI} smug at a chalkboard, the word "CARTOON" above him

text: Another sign shows cavemen living with dinosaurs.
scene: {CAVE} shocked in a museum, the word "DINOSAURS" above him

text: The last dinosaurs died about sixty-six million years before humans existed.
scene: a timeline, a stone tablet with "66", the word "MILLION" above it

text: And a sign says cavemen only grunted.
scene: {CAVE} angry in a museum, the word "GRUNT" above him

text: A Neanderthal throat bone from Kebara Cave in Israel looks almost exactly like ours.
scene: {SCI} thinking at a chalkboard, the word "KEBARA" above him

text: And Oog isn't even a Neanderthal. He talks plenty. Just not in your language.
scene: {CAVE} shouting in a museum, the word "OOG" above him

text: Oog fixes every sign.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a museum, sparkles

text: He shows kids how to make a spear.
scene: {CAVE} happy, holding a spear, in a museum, three children happy

text: How to start a fire without a lighter.
scene: {CAVE} happy by a campfire in a museum, three children shocked

text: And how to sleep with one ear open.
scene: {CAVE} asleep in a museum, z letters, the word "LISTEN" above him

text: Visitors love him.
scene: three visitors happy in a museum, hearts

text: Timer: forever.
scene: {CAVE} proud in a museum, hearts, sparkles [TIMER FOREVER]

text: So, how long would a caveman last in your job?
scene: {CAVE} thinking in an office, a big question mark

text: Probably not long.
scene: {CAVE} sad in an office, the word "FIRED" above him

text: He'd never complain about the commute, though.
scene: {CAVE} smug in a city street, the word "COMMUTE" above him

text: Ten kilometers on foot before breakfast is just a normal morning for him.
scene: {CAVE} happy, arms in the air, in a city street, the word "10 KM" above him

text: But give him a few months to learn,
scene: {CAVE} smiling holding a book in a library, sparkles

text: and the same brain that tracked mammoths would track spreadsheets.
scene: {CAVE} happy in an office with a computer, the word "SPREADSHEET" above him

text: Now tell us in the comments: what's your job,
scene: {GUY} thinking in a living room, a question mark

text: and how fast would Oog get fired from it?
scene: {CAVE} smug in an office, the word "YOUR JOB" above him [TIMER ?]

text: Next time, we flip it around: how long would you last in Oog's world?
scene: {GUY} terrified in the snow at night, a wolf angry, the word "NEXT" above him [TIMER ?]
